newsitem.title: UK: LIFFE sugar slides, coffee ends lower, cocoa stead.
newsitem.headline: LIFFE sugar slides, coffee ends lower, cocoa stead.

text.p: SUGAR - Spot May tumbles in pre-expiry squaring and NY weakness. Down $4.30 at $307.50 at 1605 GMT. COFFEE - Ends weaker but off lows, May/July active before first notice day. Market prepares for GCA data. May down $5 at $1,559. COCOA - Late short covering boosts prices but volume remains thin. May closes up one at 1,013 stg.
